name: a second fix cycle with no named blocker worth it delivers the draft instead
about: The proof check's gaps shrank after the first round (3, then 2), so the old rule started a second round. The stop judge sees the whole run and finds no named blocker worth another cycle: the draft goes out with the gaps under Open items.

replies.assumption: the remaining 2 gaps are unproven details a reviewer can confirm; deliver the draft with them listed
deliver the draft; the gaps are listed under Open items for a person to confirm
no gap names a defect; the draft goes out with the gaps as open items
